messages:
Maya Rivera: Quick microcopy review for the batching tooltip on the model config page. Current tooltip is long and a bit technical: "Batching aggregates requests to improve throughput at the cost of higher tail latency. Configure max_batch_size and max_wait_ms."
Ethan Liu: Yeah that leans infra-heavy. Users on the console might not know what max_wait_ms means.
Priya Desai: Agree. We should explain the user impact first and keep the knobs as a short secondary note.
Maya Rivera: Proposed concise title: "Batching improves throughput" body: "Groups requests to reduce cost and increase throughput. Larger batches can raise response time for individual requests." Tertiary: "Advanced: max_batch_size, max_wait_ms"
Ethan Liu: Love the user-first framing. Maybe swap wording to "may increase response latency for single requests" to avoid implying constant slowness.
Priya Desai: Also add an inline example for clarity: "E.g., small real-time APIs: keep batch size low; high-throughput ingest: increase batch size."
Maya Rivera: Nice. Accessibility: tooltip needs aria-describedby and not rely on hover alone. Also ensure the example is hidden behind a "More info" link for screen readers to expand.
design-bot: Accessibility lint: ensure tooltip has role="tooltip" and an accessible trigger element with aria-expanded when expanded. Do not use "learn more" link text alone.
Ethan Liu: For localization keys let's use: `tooltips.batching.title`, `.body`, `.advanced_label`, `.example_short`. Keep them short.
Priya Desai: Microcopy draft: Title: "Batching improves throughput" Body: "Groups requests to lower cost and increase throughput. Larger batches may increase latency for single requests." Advanced label: "Advanced settings: max_batch_size · max_wait_ms" Example (expand): "Example: keep batch size small for low-latency APIs; increase it for bulk workloads."
Maya Rivera: Small UX nit: prefer 'increase latency for single requests' -> 'may increase latency for individual requests' (softer). Also change bullet separator to middot for compactness.
Ethan Liu: I'll update the tooltip component to use a collapsible region with keyboard focus and wire the aria-labels. Adding telemetry event `ui.tooltip.batching.view_more`.
Priya Desai: Can we also include a one-line link to "See recommended presets" pointing to the autoscale/batching docs? Make link text descriptive (e.g., "See batching presets") per design-bot.
Maya Rivera: Final copy I want in the translations file:
- tooltips.batching.title = "Batching improves throughput"
- tooltips.batching.body = "Groups requests to lower cost and increase throughput. Larger batches may increase latency for individual requests."
- tooltips.batching.advanced = "Advanced settings: max_batch_size · max_wait_ms"
- tooltips.batching.example = "Example: keep batch size small for low-latency APIs; increase it for bulk workloads."
- tooltips.batching.link = "See batching presets"
Ethan Liu: PR soon, I'll include aria attributes and tests for keyboard + screen reader flow.
Priya Desai: LGTM from content. Nice and compact.
Maya Rivera: Thanks all :sparkles:
